test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence into direct speech:

The manager informed the employees that the deadline for submission had been extended by two days.

options.text: The manager said to the employees, “The deadline for submission has been extended by two days.”
The manager said to the employees, “The deadline for submission will be extended by two days.”
The manager told the employees, “The deadline for submission is extended by two days.”
The manager said, “You must submit the work after two days.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **indirect speech** and uses the reporting verb **informed**, which can be converted to “said to” or “told” in direct speech.
 
• The reported clause contains the past perfect tense: **“had been extended”**.
 
• When converting to direct speech, the tense usually shifts back to simple present perfect: **“has been extended”**.
 
• Therefore, the correct direct speech is: “The deadline for submission **has been extended** by two days.”
 
• Option 1 correctly reflects this transformation with proper tense and structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *“The manager said to the employees, **‘The deadline for submission has been extended by two days.’**”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** Uses “will be extended,” which changes the tense and meaning.
 
• **Option 3:** “is extended” is incorrect; present simple does not match the original meaning.
 
• **Option 4:** Completely changes the message; not a correct conversion.
